heroHeadline: Alleged Assassination Plot Against PM Tusk and Defense Minister Uncovered — Investigation Underway
heroSubtitle: Polish authorities revealed an alleged plot to assassinate Prime Minister Donald Tusk and Defense Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz, marking a severe escalation of political violence risk inside a frontline NATO state bordering Ukraine. The ABW (Internal Security Agency) is leading the investigation; investigators are probing potential foreign-linked networks behind the plot.
footerNote: Data sourced from official Polish government statements, major international outlets, and institutional analyses.
